name: Thich Ca Phat Dai
summary: Walk the complex on Trần Phú for the seated Buddha, the 12 metre reclining figure, and the sculptures of Siddhartha’s life. It is a Big Mountain visit, separate from Christ the King on Small Mountain. The museum article and the tourism catalogue do not agree on the ranking date. A fee and a gate hour are check on arrival.
getThere: Trần Phú, on the Big Mountain side.
heroCaption: The reclining figure at Thich Ca Phat Dai, full length

notice.title: The ranking dates do not match
notice.body: The museum article dates decision 1987/VHQĐ to 14 February 1981. The tourism catalogue dates 1987/VH.QĐ to 14 December 1989. The relic list says a national ranking in 1989. All three are printed. None is dropped.

body: The complex is Thích Ca Phật Đài, with Thiền Lâm Tự, on Trần Phú. The museum article places it in ward 5 on Big Mountain, Núi Tương Kỳ. The relic list prints 610 Trần Phú. Built from July 1961 to March 1963, on the museum article.

The seated Buddha is 10 metres overall, a 4 metre base and a 6 metre body. A 12 metre reclining figure is at the top, which is the figure in the photograph. The museum article says 16 relic beads and a bodhi branch are kept here, and the grounds hold sculptures of Siddhartha’s life. The gate carries the name of the complex.
A best hour and a ticket are not printed. Come in the daytime. Do not budget the Christ stair count for this hill. Those steps are on Small Mountain.

gettingThere: The complex is on Trần Phú, on the Big Mountain side of the peninsula. The relic list prints 610 Trần Phú. Minutes from Back Beach or from the cable-car station at 1A Trần Phú are not printed.

legs.heading: From the Ho May station
legs.body: Both are on Trần Phú. The station is 1A. The relic list prints the pagoda at 610. Walk minutes between them are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Front Beach
legs.body: Up onto the Big Mountain side and Trần Phú. Minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No weekly close is printed. Check on arrival.
